premises: *tvatpādapadmasamparkamātrasambhogasaṅginam.* Joined in enjoyment by mere touch-contact of Your lotus-feet — bring me, Lord, by the neck into Your house. Entry by touch, not merit; "by the neck" (*galepādikayā*) — force asked for.
reconstruction: *tvatpādapadmasamparkamātrasambhogasaṅginam.* Joined in enjoyment by mere touch-contact of Your lotus-feet — bring me, Lord, by the neck into Your house. Entry by touch, not merit; "by the neck" (*galepādikayā*) — force asked for.

premises: *bhavatpādāmbujarajorājirañjitamūrdhajaḥ.* Head hair dyed by Your foot-lotus-dust-redness — when shall I frantically begin to dance? Dust as dye; dance as the question's form. (Lakshmanjoo: holding His feet, wiping their dust.)
reconstruction: *bhavatpādāmbujarajorājirañjitamūrdhajaḥ.* Head hair dyed by Your foot-lotus-dust-redness — when shall I frantically begin to dance? Dust as dye; dance as the question's form. (Lakshmanjoo: holding His feet, wiping their dust.)

premises: *tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā.* You my sole Lord — this alone I always ask: dwelling inside You, may I be silent; otherwise, wise. Silence over wisdom: *mūka* (dumb) beats *budha* (clever). The anti-eloquence verse.
reconstruction: *tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā.* You my sole Lord — this alone I always ask: dwelling inside You, may I be silent; otherwise, wise. Silence over wisdom: *mūka* (dumb) beats *budha* (clever). The anti-eloquence verse.

premises: *aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana.* Ah nectar-ocean master! Ah sweet three-eyed One! Ah tasty deformed-eyed One! — thus may I dance, shouting. Praise by exclamation; three *aho*s as liturgy.
reconstruction: *aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana.* Ah nectar-ocean master! Ah sweet three-eyed One! Ah tasty deformed-eyed One! — thus may I dance, shouting. Praise by exclamation; three *aho*s as liturgy.

premises: *tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśaparimīlitalocanaḥ.* Eyes half-closed by Your foot-lotus-touch — may I expand, reeling drunk on Your devotion-liquor-madness. Touch narrows sight, widens being.
reconstruction: *tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśaparimīlitalocanaḥ.* Eyes half-closed by Your foot-lotus-touch — may I expand, reeling drunk on Your devotion-liquor-madness. Touch narrows sight, widens being.

premises: *cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā.* May I dwell anywhere, O All-pervading, mind-mountain on earth, where that practice is — uninterrupted, great-rasa, made of Your prattle. Dwelling defined by practice, not place.
reconstruction: *cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā.* May I dwell anywhere, O All-pervading, mind-mountain on earth, where that practice is — uninterrupted, great-rasa, made of Your prattle. Dwelling defined by practice, not place.

premises: *yatra devīsametas tvam.* Where You stand with the Goddess, many-formed, from palace to gate-tower — in that city may I dwell. The divine household as address; *bahurūpa* domesticated.
reconstruction: *yatra devīsametas tvam.* Where You stand with the Goddess, many-formed, from palace to gate-tower — in that city may I dwell. The divine household as address; *bahurūpa* domesticated.

premises: *samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ.* May Your sun-rays rejoice, Lord, until my heart-lotus blooms — for Your worship. Blooming as the rays' festival, not the devotee's work.
reconstruction: *samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ.* May Your sun-rays rejoice, Lord, until my heart-lotus blooms — for Your worship. Blooming as the rays' festival, not the devotee's work.

premises: *prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā.* Favor me, Lord, so that my mind, fallen ever at Your feet, tasting this and that — melts like wax, flows like... Wax-mind: tasting melts; melting is the prayer.
reconstruction: *prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā.* Favor me, Lord, so that my mind, fallen ever at Your feet, tasting this and that — melts like wax, flows like... Wax-mind: tasting melts; melting is the prayer.

premises: *praharṣād vātha śokād vā.* Whether from joy bursting pot-lids, or sorrow — from outside or inside feeling, appear to me, Lord. Any trigger suffices; appear regardless of cause.
reconstruction: *praharṣād vātha śokād vā.* Whether from joy bursting pot-lids, or sorrow — from outside or inside feeling, appear to me, Lord. Any trigger suffices; appear regardless of cause.

premises: *bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me.* Outside too, inside too — may that ever-streaming, Your coolest foot-lotus-touch-nectar, be mine always. Streaming touch, both directions.
reconstruction: *bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me.* Outside too, inside too — may that ever-streaming, Your coolest foot-lotus-touch-nectar, be mine always. Streaming touch, both directions.

premises: *tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam.* Plunging inside Your touch-nectar-lake — may that pleasure beyond all pleasures be mine always. Pleasure (*bhoga*) that surpasses (*laṅghī*) all pleasure.
reconstruction: *tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam.* Plunging inside Your touch-nectar-lake — may that pleasure beyond all pleasures be mine always. Pleasure (*bhoga*) that surpasses (*laṅghī*) all pleasure.

premises: *niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā.* Take what I offer — passion and the rest, Lord; make it nectar and eat it with devotees. The passions cooked into nectar and shared: offering as cuisine.
reconstruction: *niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā.* Take what I offer — passion and the rest, Lord; make it nectar and eat it with devotees. The passions cooked into nectar and shared: offering as cuisine.

premises: *aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam.* Ever-full on whole-world-food, happily seated — Master, cast Your grace-glance-moment on servants. The world-eater asked for one glance at servants.
reconstruction: *aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam.* Ever-full on whole-world-food, happily seated — Master, cast Your grace-glance-moment on servants. The world-eater asked for one glance at servants.

premises: *antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ.* Eyes half-closed, chewing inner devotion-wonder — "bow to me, to Śiva" — may I worship even straw. Self as Śiva addressed; straw as liturgy-worthy.
reconstruction: *antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ.* Eyes half-closed, chewing inner devotion-wonder — "bow to me, to Śiva" — may I worship even straw. Self as Śiva addressed; straw as liturgy-worthy.

premises: *api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ.* Though I have gained Your being — seeing the world as my self-blaze — may I be unparted by devotion-rasa-enjoyments. Gaining without leaving: enjoyment as non-parting's seal.
reconstruction: *api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ.* Though I have gained Your being — seeing the world as my self-blaze — may I be unparted by devotion-rasa-enjoyments. Gaining without leaving: enjoyment as non-parting's seal.

premises: *ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate.* Since nothing else is to be desired, Lord — to You, the secondless, fullness is fitting. Desire's end as fitness-proof.
reconstruction: *ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate.* Since nothing else is to be desired, Lord — to You, the secondless, fullness is fitting. Desire's end as fitness-proof.

premises: *hasyate nṛtyate yatra.* Where there is laughter, dancing, where passion-aversion are eaten, devotion-nectar drunk — may I reach that place. The festival as destination.
reconstruction: *hasyate nṛtyate yatra.* Where there is laughter, dancing, where passion-aversion are eaten, devotion-nectar drunk — may I reach that place. The festival as destination.

premises: *tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā.* May that unprecedented-joy-perfume of thought-flowers about You firm up in my mind — till bad-smell of bad-habit perishes. Fragrance vs stink: thought's smell decides.
reconstruction: *tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā.* May that unprecedented-joy-perfume of thought-flowers about You firm up in my mind — till bad-smell of bad-habit perishes. Fragrance vs stink: thought's smell decides.

premises: *kva nu rāgādiṣu rāgaḥ kva ca haracaraṇāmbujeṣu rāgitvam.* Where is love among passions, and where is loving at Hari's lotus-feet — thus teach my contradiction-loving heart what is good, O Deathless. Comparison as instruction; the heart addressed as contradiction-lover.
reconstruction: *kva nu rāgādiṣu rāgaḥ kva ca haracaraṇāmbujeṣu rāgitvam.* Where is love among passions, and where is loving at Hari's lotus-feet — thus teach my contradiction-loving heart what is good, O Deathless. Comparison as instruction; the heart addressed as contradiction-lover.

premises: *vicaran yogadaśāsv api.* Though wandering even through yogic states, though turned away from objects — may I be only heart-melted by Your-thought-liquor-madness. States passed through, not dwelt in; melting only by Him.
reconstruction: *vicaran yogadaśāsv api.* Though wandering even through yogic states, though turned away from objects — may I be only heart-melted by Your-thought-liquor-madness. States passed through, not dwelt in; melting only by Him.

premises: *vāci manomatiṣu tathā śarīraceṣṭāsu.* In speech, mind-thoughts, body-gestures made by senses — everywhere, always, may bhakti-rasa go before me as leader. Devotion as vanguard (*puraḥsara*) of every faculty.
reconstruction: *vāci manomatiṣu tathā śarīraceṣṭāsu.* In speech, mind-thoughts, body-gestures made by senses — everywhere, always, may bhakti-rasa go before me as leader. Devotion as vanguard (*puraḥsara*) of every faculty.

premises: *śivaśivaśiveti nāmani tava niravadhi.* While Your name "Śiva Śiva Śiva" is chanted endlessly, Lord — may I taste some great unrepeatable rasa. The Name's infinity; the taste's unrepeatability.
reconstruction: *śivaśivaśiveti nāmani tava niravadhi.* While Your name "Śiva Śiva Śiva" is chanted endlessly, Lord — may I taste some great unrepeatable rasa. The Name's infinity; the taste's unrepeatability.

premises: *sphuradanantacidātmakaviṣṭape.* In the vastness flashing as endless consciousness-self, where all dull paths are drunk up — may I roam Your worship, countless consciousness-made ramparts uncounted. Roaming, not arriving.
reconstruction: *sphuradanantacidātmakaviṣṭape.* In the vastness flashing as endless consciousness-self, where all dull paths are drunk up — may I roam Your worship, countless consciousness-made ramparts uncounted. Roaming, not arriving.

premises: *svavapuṣi sphuṭabhāsini śāśvate.* For standing in self-body, clearly shining, eternal — nothing else is of use; firm be this thought — but dust of Your pure feet, O Lord. Self-sufficiency confessed — then the one exception: foot-dust.
reconstruction: *svavapuṣi sphuṭabhāsini śāśvate.* For standing in self-body, clearly shining, eternal — nothing else is of use; firm be this thought — but dust of Your pure feet, O Lord. Self-sufficiency confessed — then the one exception: foot-dust.

premises: *kim api nātha kadācana cetasi sphurati.* Something flashes sometime in mind, touching Your feet — where this whole world melts — show it always, in the nectar-lake, Lord. Close: a flash, feet touched, world melted; "show always."
reconstruction: *kim api nātha kadācana cetasi sphurati.* Something flashes sometime in mind, touching Your feet — where this whole world melts — show it always, in the nectar-lake, Lord. Close: a flash, feet touched, world melted; "show always."
